_about: The farm prototypes (proto-farm, 1 Nov 2026; Zafar's notes, build/reports/designs/prototype-notes-2026-11-01.md): the words and lines the four farm games need that the family has not recorded yet. Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record; build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.

ph-cow.src: Zafar's word is gai (docs/game-design/days/farm.md, to record): never shipped unconfirmed
